source_name: ПАТ «МТБ БАНК» — Фінансові звіти / Інформація для акціонерів та стейкхолдерів
why_relevant: MTB Bank (Odesa region, private) maintains an unusually well-structured disclosure tree: financial reports, management report, and separate board/supervisory-board reports — each on its own stable URL, plus an English mirror.

source_name: НБУ — Структура власності банків (bank ownership structure register)
why_relevant: Authoritative regulator-side confirmation of which banks are domestically privately owned and who their ultimate beneficiaries are — the definitive way to keep the private-bank actor list correct as ownership changes (e.g. nationalisations, sales).

source_name: Cbonds — FUIB issuer profile (ratings, bonds, financial tables)
why_relevant: Aggregator profile carrying FUIB's LEI, credit ratings, news and normalised accounting/financial tables — useful for time-series cross-checks and for spotting debt issuance by Ukrainian private banks.

source_name: Clarity Project — company file for АТ «БАНК КРЕДИТ ДНІПРО» (EDRPOU 14352406)
why_relevant: Aggregates registry data, filings, court cases and tender activity per legal entity — a fast way to validate identity/EDRPOU, spot related non-bank entities, and cross-reference disclosure gaps for any private bank in the cell.

source_name: Мінфін (minfin.com.ua) — bank profile pages incl. liquidated АКБ «Конкорд»
why_relevant: Practical continuity source for banks whose own sites go dark. Concord (the acquirer/processing bank behind several Ukrainian fintechs) had its licence revoked on 01.08.2023 and liquidation completed 05.05.2026 — its own disclosure pages are gone, so aggregator and DGF records are the only remaining route.

source_name: ТАСКОМБАНК (izibank; ex-Sportbank) — corporate/ESG and reporting site
why_relevant: Tascombank (TAS Group, same owner as Universal Bank/monobank) is the licence-holder behind izibank and absorbed Sportbank's clients when Sportbank closed on 06.05.2024. Its reporting and ESG/news channels are the disclosure route for that neobank cluster.

source_name: SMIDA — «Опублікування регульованої інформації» feed (post-01/07/2021 regulated-information stream)
why_relevant: The live chronological stream of regulated information filed by issuers and providers of security: interim and annual financial disclosures, special/irregular corporate announcements, emission decisions, auditor reports and prospectuses. Filterable by legal-entity name, EDRPOU, report type (100+ categories) and date range — the primary monitoring feed for bank/payments issuer events.

source_name: НКЦПФР Open Data API (stockmarket.gov.ua/api/v1) — issuer and market report indexes
why_relevant: Machine-readable XML indexes of the disclosure database: issuer reports, exchange transactions, off-exchange trader reports, mortgage managers, rating agencies and regulated-information publication. Supports edrpou, period (daily/monthly/quarterly/annual/irregular), date/fdate/sdate and limit/idlast parameters — the cleanest bulk ingestion path for issuer filings.

source_name: ЕСКРІН — Електронна система комплексного розкриття інформації емітентами (SMIDA)
why_relevant: ESCRIN holds quarterly and special information disclosed by issuers of shares and bonds admitted to trading on organised markets — i.e. exactly the listed/bond-issuing banks. It is the higher-frequency layer above annual reporting.

source_name: data.gov.ua — набір даних «Інформація, що міститься в Загальнодоступній інформаційній базі даних про ринок цінних паперів»
why_relevant: Bulk open-data mirror of the NSSMC disclosure database on the national open-data portal — a licence-clean, versioned ingestion path that avoids scraping the live portal.

source_name: data.gov.ua — «Відомості про власників значних пакетів акцій емітентів цінних паперів» / NSSMC owners API
why_relevant: Ownership of 5%+/10%+ stakes in joint-stock issuers, compiled from depository institutions' quarterly administrative reports. For banking and payments this reveals ultimate beneficial control, group structure and stake changes — critical for competitor and partner mapping.

source_name: SMIDA — база даних «Власники» (large stake holders, 5%+)
why_relevant: SMIDA's own shareholder-stake database across reporting periods; complements the NSSMC owners API with historical periodisation useful for tracking control changes at banks.

source_name: SMIDA — база даних «Правопорушення» (securities market violations since 2002)
why_relevant: Records of NSSMC sanctions and violations by issuers since 2002. An indirect but strong risk/compliance signal: repeated non-disclosure sanctions against a bank or finance company flag governance stress and also confirm which entities are within the disclosure perimeter.

source_name: SMIDA — база даних «Учасники ринку» (professional participants: traders, custodians, depositories, asset managers, auditors)
why_relevant: Enumerates licensed professional capital-market participants. Many are bank subsidiaries or bank-affiliated securities traders/custodians; the auditor field also reveals which audit firms sign Ukrainian bank statements — a useful onward pointer for the audit/assurance source cell.

source_name: НКЦПФР — офіційний сайт регулятора (nssmc.gov.ua): рішення, новини, прес-релізи
why_relevant: The regulator's own site publishes Commission decisions (registration of securities issues, approval of prospectuses, suspension of circulation), press releases and thematic Q&A on issuer disclosure. Announcements of approved bank bond prospectuses and enforcement appear here before or alongside the database entries.

source_name: НКЦПФР — «Затвердження проспекту цінних паперів» / адміністративні послуги з реєстрації випусків
why_relevant: Defines the procedural pipeline by which a bank bond prospectus becomes public: what is filed, in what form, and where the resulting act is published. Necessary to know so the collection pipeline targets the right artefact types and timing.

source_name: Положення про розкриття інформації емітентами цінних паперів (z1307-23) та Положення про Державний реєстр випусків цінних паперів (z0772-24) — zakon.rada.gov.ua
why_relevant: The binding rulebook that fixes what issuers (including banks and providers of security for bonds) must disclose, in what XML form, on what deadlines, and via which venue (Commission database vs. an authorised regulated-information publisher). It is the schema authority for any parser built on these filings.

source_name: SMIDA XML Report — схеми XML файлів звітності емітентів (Наказ №35 від 20.03.2024)
why_relevant: Machine-readable schemas and the 'склад інформації' definitions for annual/interim issuer reports and for special information. These are the field dictionaries needed to parse the filings for banks — e.g. which tags carry capital, results, governance and related-party data.

source_name: stockmarket.gov.ua — архів опублікування регульованої інформації (до 30/06/2021) та стрічка повідомлень
why_relevant: Historical archive of issuer regulated-information filings up to 30 June 2021, before publication migrated to authorised publishers. Needed for multi-year time series on bank issuers (pre-2021 annual/special information) that the current feed does not carry.

source_name: SMIDA кабінет клієнта / nonres.smida.gov.ua (client and non-resident cabinets)
why_relevant: The filing-side cabinets used by issuers and by non-resident entities. Not a content source in itself, but it confirms the submission channel and the existence of a distinct non-resident track — relevant when a foreign payments group's Ukrainian vehicle files here.

source_name: SMIDA — «Друковані видання» / офіційні бюлетені НКЦПФР
why_relevant: Registry of official Commission publications and bulletins. Historically the venue where issuer notices were also printed; useful for pre-digital backfill and for tracing which outlets carry statutory notices.

source_name: Колегія АРІФРУ/СМІДА та новини SMIDA (governance and system-change announcements)
why_relevant: SMIDA's news stream announces changes to the XML report application, register expansions (ISIN/LEI search) and system migrations. Early warning that a parser or crawler will break, and a record of when disclosure scope changed.

source_name: arc.nssmc.gov.ua — архівна версія сайту НКЦПФР (SMIDA description, historical pages)
why_relevant: The regulator's archived website preserves older descriptions of the disclosure infrastructure and prior URL structures — useful for resolving link rot and for reconstructing how the disclosure system was organised before the 2021 migration.

source_name: NBU — Oversight of financial market infrastructures (оверсайт платіжної інфраструктури)
why_relevant: Hosts the NBU's annual oversight report on payment systems and the annually approved list of important payment infrastructure objects (2025 list: Visa, Mastercard, PrivatMoney, NovaPay, Ukrainian Payment System 'Financial World'). Also defines the >10% share threshold that flags an important e-money issuer — a rare quantitative window on non-bank issuer scale.

source_name: NBU — Payments and Settlements statistics hub
why_relevant: Publishes payment market volume/value series (cards, transfers, e-money, terminal networks) which is the denominator against which any individual PSP's disclosed volumes must be read.

source_name: NBU legal acts repository (admin_uploads/law) — payment services regulations
why_relevant: Where the NBU posts the resolutions that define reporting duties, licence conditions and register content for payment institutions and e-money issuers. Determines what these firms are legally obliged to disclose.

source_name: Zakon Rada — Law On Payment Services and implementing regulations
why_relevant: Statutory basis for the licensing categories (платіжна установа, установа електронних грошей, філія іноземної платіжної установи) and for their statutory reporting. Needed to reason about which disclosures are mandatory versus voluntary.
